response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_amount FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE o.amount > 2802 GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM g) SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.avg_amount, g.avg_amount - overall.overall_avg AS diff FROM g CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: 'Large' means order.amount strictly greater than 2802 (cutoff itself excluded).
The overall figure is the simple (unweighted) average of the group averages, as the request states, not the average over individual orders.
Ties in the difference are broken arbitrarily, since the request gives no tie-break.

alternatives.interpretation: Large orders are those with amount >= 2802 (cutoff inclusive).
